== Published English Original Virtual Set 8 wording ==
The November replacement attaches to Jabba, changes the reach of activation and battle destiny, and gives a non-Jedi target at the battle. The remaster expressly requires the target to be present with Jabba. The period ruling on cancellation during activation describes the effect of the related-site generation clause.
